title: 2001 太空漫游
creator: Stanley Kubrick
note: 从猿骨到星童，用极简对白铺陈人类进化的宏大冥想。
noteEn: From bone to star-child, a cosmic meditation told with near-silence.

title: 银翼杀手
creator: Ridley Scott
note: 赛博朋克视觉的原点，雨夜霓虹下的复制人悲歌。
noteEn: The neon-noir blueprint of cyberpunk, mourning replicants in the rain.

title: 异形
creator: Ridley Scott
note: 把太空船变成屠宰场，让太空恐怖落回脏兮兮的现实。
noteEn: Turns a starship into a slaughterhouse, grounding space horror in grime.

title: 星球大战
creator: George Lucas
note: 用太空歌剧重启好莱坞暑期档，把原力变成世代神话。
noteEn: Rebooted the Hollywood blockbuster as space opera, building a generational myth.

title: 黑客帝国
creator: The Wachowskis
note: 子弹时间与红蓝药丸，把存在主义问号装进动作片。
noteEn: Bullet-time and the red pill folded philosophy into action filmmaking.

title: 盗梦空间
creator: Christopher Nolan
note: 梦境嵌套的陀螺永不停转，诺兰把偷盗片拍成脑内迷宫。
noteEn: A spinning top inside nested dreams — Nolan's maze of the mind.

title: 星际穿越
creator: Christopher Nolan
note: 黑洞、五维书架与麦田，父女情跨越引力与时间。
noteEn: A black hole, a tesseract and a father-daughter bond spanning gravity and time.

title: 降临
creator: Denis Villeneuve
note: 语言学家用非线性时间观改写第一类接触。
noteEn: A linguist redefines first contact through a non-linear view of time.

title: 沙丘
creator: Denis Villeneuve
note: 沙丘美学与巨型尺度，维伦纽瓦把厄拉科斯拍成神迹。
noteEn: Desert colossalism — Villeneuve's awe-scale adaptation of Herbert's epic.

title: 攻壳机动队
creator: Mamoru Oshii
note: 素子与傀儡师的哲学对话，奠定赛博朋克动画语法。
noteEn: Major Kusanagi's identity duel with the Puppet Master, a cyberpunk animation landmark.

title: 阿基拉
creator: Katsuhiro Otomo
note: 赛博东京的失控觉醒，手绘动画的暴力美学巅峰。
noteEn: Neo-Tokyo's psychic meltdown, the peak of hand-drawn animated mayhem.

title: 飞向太空
creator: Andrei Tarkovsky
note: 海洋行星用记忆吞噬船员，塔可夫斯基对太空歌剧的哲学反写。
noteEn: A sentient ocean resurrects memories; Tarkovsky's philosophical answer to space opera.

title: 潜行者
creator: Andrei Tarkovsky
note: 穿越「区」的朝圣之旅，把科幻拍成形而上学。
noteEn: A pilgrimage through the Zone that turns sci-fi into metaphysics.

title: 大都会
creator: Fritz Lang
note: 1927 年的摩天都市寓言，机器人玛丽亚开创银幕科幻造型。
noteEn: A 1927 fable of the vertical city and the robot Maria, founding sci-fi imagery.

title: 人类之子
creator: Alfonso Cuarón
note: 一镜到底的逃亡长镜，末世废墟里诞生的唯一婴儿。
noteEn: A one-shot war-zone escape and the last baby born into a sterile future.

title: 暖暖内含光
en: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
creator: Michel Gondry
note: 记忆清除手术中的爱情回溯，把浪漫拍成意识流。
noteEn: A memory-wipe romance that swims backwards through the mind.

title: 银翼杀手 2049
creator: Denis Villeneuve
note: 在复制人世界的废墟里寻找灵魂，摄影与配乐皆封神。
noteEn: Searching for a soul among replicant ruins, with otherworldly photography and score.

title: 她
creator: Spike Jonze
note: 操作系统成了最懂爱的「人」，孤独都市的温柔低语。
noteEn: An operating system becomes the most human lover — a tender whisper for lonely cities.

title: 终结者 2：审判日
creator: James Cameron
note: 液态金属追杀下的划时代特效，阿诺从反派变慈父。
noteEn: Liquid-metal terror rewrote visual effects; the Terminator turns protector.

title: 回到未来
creator: Robert Zemeckis
note: 德罗宁载着少年穿越 1955，把时间旅行拍成青春喜剧。
noteEn: A DeLorean joyride to 1955 that turned time travel into teenage comedy.

title: 第五元素
creator: Luc Besson
note: 吕克·贝松的高概念彩色漫画，太空歌剧的欧陆想象。
noteEn: Besson's comic-book high concept — a candy-colored European space opera.

title: 机器人总动员
creator: Andrew Stanton
note: 废土上的小机器人用眼神谈情，皮克斯最浪漫的环保寓言。
noteEn: A trash-compacting robot falls in love with a glance — Pixar's most romantic eco-fable.

title: 红辣椒
creator: Satoshi Kon
note: 今敏把梦境剪辑成蒙太奇，千层梦境如万花筒迸裂。
noteEn: Kon edits dreams into montage, a kaleidoscope of layered realities.

title: 机械姬
creator: Alex Garland
note: 图灵测试的密室反转，Ava 的美与野心令人背脊发凉。
noteEn: A chamber-room Turing test where Ava's beauty and guile chill the spine.

title: 堤
creator: Chris Marker
note: 全片几乎由静态照片构成，穿越时空只为一眼爱情。
noteEn: A time-travel story told in still photographs, all for a single glance.

title: 妙想天开
creator: Terry Gilliam
note: 官僚反乌托邦的荒诞噩梦，吉列姆的黑色寓言。
noteEn: Gilliam's Kafkaesque nightmare of bureaucracy run mad.

title: 千钧一发
creator: Andrew Niccol
note: 基因决定命运的近未来，「我不给返程留燃料」的逆袭。
noteEn: In a gene-sorted future, a 'god-child' proves will outranks DNA.

title: 火星救援
creator: Ridley Scott
note: 用科学与幽默在火星自救，NASA 自救手册的电影版。
noteEn: MacGyvering survival on Mars with science and wisecracks.

title: 指环王：护戒使者
en: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
creator: Peter Jackson
note: 中土远征的开端，从夏尔到摩瑞亚的史诗行旅。
noteEn: The quest begins — from the Shire to Moria, an epic journey into myth.

title: 指环王：双塔奇兵
en: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
creator: Peter Jackson
note: 圣盔谷一夜守城战，树人与咕噜的双线暗涌。
noteEn: Helm's Deep under siege, while Gollum and the Ents shift the tide.

title: 指环王：王者无敌
en: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
creator: Peter Jackson
note: 九人护戒团终结于末日火山，奥斯卡横扫 11 项。
noteEn: The quest ends at Mount Doom in a sweep of eleven Oscars.

title: 哈利·波特与魔法石
en: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
creator: Chris Columbus
note: 魔法石开启霍格沃茨世界，全球孩子的共同童年。
noteEn: Hogwarts opens its doors — the shared childhood of a generation.

title: 潘神的迷宫
creator: Guillermo del Toro
note: 法西斯阴影下小女孩的黑暗童话，现实与幻境互噬。
noteEn: A dark fairy tale under Franco's shadow where reality and fable devour each other.

title: 公主新娘
creator: Rob Reiner
note: 真爱与剑术的童话恶作剧，台词被引用到如今。
noteEn: A fairy-tale swashbuckler of true love and wit, endlessly quoted.

title: 哈尔的移动城堡
creator: Hayao Miyazaki
note: 宫崎骏用移动城堡解构战争与衰老，苏菲的勇气是魔法。
noteEn: Miyazaki's walking castle against war and age — Sophie's magic is courage.

title: 龙猫
creator: Hayao Miyazaki
note: 龙猫巴士驶过乡野夏天，宫崎骏最温柔的生态乡愁。
noteEn: A Catbus across a country summer — Miyazaki's tenderest ode to nature.

title: 幽灵公主
creator: Hayao Miyazaki
note: 人与森林之战的史诗，幽灵公主扛起生态寓言。
noteEn: An epic clash between industry and forest, a call against war on nature.

title: 大魔域
creator: Wolfgang Petersen
note: 男孩从书页进入幻想国，童年在龙与飞行中永续。
noteEn: A boy falls into a book's world, where childhood never ends.

title: 绿野仙踪
creator: Victor Fleming
note: 黄砖路上的桃乐茜，彩色宽银幕的奇幻原典。
noteEn: Dorothy's yellow-brick odyssey — the ur-text of screen fantasy.

title: 星尘
creator: Matthew Vaughn
note: 流星坠落的英国童话镇，海盗船长与王子争夺星星。
noteEn: A fallen star, a sky pirate and a prince — a cozy British fairy-tale caper.

title: 鬼妈妈
creator: Henry Selick
note: 纽扣眼的另一个妈妈，莱卡的定格动画暗黑魔法。
noteEn: A button-eyed Other Mother — Laika's stop-motion dark enchantment.

title: 水形物语
creator: Guillermo del Toro
note: 人鱼与哑女相拥于冷战实验室，爱的形状跨越物种。
noteEn: A mute woman and an amphibian god embrace in a Cold War lab.

title: 魔幻迷宫
creator: Jim Henson
note: 吉姆·亨森的木偶迷宫，大卫·鲍伊的紧身裤与妖歌。
noteEn: Henson's puppet labyrinth, with David Bowie's Goblin King and songs.

title: 风之谷
en: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
creator: Hayao Miyazaki
note: 腐海与巨虫的末日生态诗，娜乌西卡是风之谷的救赎。
noteEn: An eco-parable of the toxic jungle and the girl who rides the wind.

title: 绿衣骑士
creator: David Lowery
note: 高文骑士的绿林试炼，亚瑟王传说的仪式化改编。
noteEn: Gawain's chivalric trial reimagined as a slow, ritualistic fable.

title: 闪灵
creator: Stanley Kubrick
note: 全景酒店的走廊迷宫与打字机「只工作不玩耍」，库布里克把恐怖拍成几何。
noteEn: A maze-hotel and an axe-wielding father — Kubrick's horror of cold geometry.

title: 惊魂记
creator: Alfred Hitchcock
note: 浴室戏 78 个机位剪出 45 秒，希区柯克改写恐怖电影语法。
noteEn: The 78-shot shower scene rewrote the grammar of screen terror.

title: 驱魔人
creator: William Friedkin
note: 绿豌豆汤与倒走楼梯，宗教恐怖的天花板之作。
noteEn: The benchmark of religious horror, from pea soup to backward stair-walks.

title: 午夜凶铃
creator: Hideo Nakata
note: 录像带七日诅咒，开启日式心理恐怖的全球浪潮。
noteEn: A cursed videotape and seven days — the wave-maker of J-horror.

title: 咒怨
creator: Takashi Shimizu
note: 怨念盘踞老宅，伽椰子的爬梯声成为都市噩梦。
noteEn: A curse that lives in a house — Kayako's crawl-scratch haunts a decade.

title: 切肤之爱
creator: Takashi Miike
note: 相亲变酷刑的缓慢窒息，三池崇史把日常撕出血腥。
noteEn: A blind-date romance curdles into torture — Miike's surgical shock.

title: 哭声
creator: Na Hong-jin
note: 韩国山村驱魔疑云，邪灵与病毒纠缠的多义恐怖。
noteEn: A Korean village, a shaman and a demon — ambiguity as dread.

title: 蔷花，红莲
creator: Kim Jee-woon
note: 韩式心理恐怖杰作，姐妹与继母的镜像纠葛。
noteEn: A masterpiece of Korean psychological horror, a mirror-maze of family grief.

title: 釜山行
creator: Yeon Sang-ho
note: 丧尸列车的封闭空间逃杀，韩影工业的类型爆发。
noteEn: A zombie outbreak on a Seoul-bound train — K-horror at full throttle.

title: 遗传厄运
creator: Ari Aster
note: 家族遗传的创伤与邪教，被视作「现代恐怖已死」的回应。
noteEn: Grief and a cult conspiracy run in the blood — a new horror benchmark.

title: 仲夏夜惊魂
creator: Ari Aster
note: 白昼永昼下的瑞典祭祀，分手电影变成民俗噩梦。
noteEn: Sunlit pagan rites turn a breakup into a folk-horror nightmare.

title: 逃出绝命镇
creator: Jordan Peele
note: 黑人体检变器官移植，把种族议题装进惊悚容器。
noteEn: A liberal getaway that hides body-snatching — race as horror.

title: 鬼书
creator: Jennifer Kent
note: 绘本怪物与丧夫创伤，把恐惧拍成单亲妈妈的战争。
noteEn: A pop-up monster born of grief — one mother's war against the dark.

title: 女巫
creator: Robert Eggers
note: 新英格兰清教徒家庭的信仰崩塌，「魔鬼就在树林里」。
noteEn: A Puritan family's faith unravels — the devil is real in the wood.

title: 阴风阵阵
creator: Dario Argento
note: 芭蕾学院的血色霓虹，阿基多的彩色噩梦。
noteEn: A ballet academy bathed in giallo neon — Argento's lurid nightmare.

title: 诺斯费拉图
creator: F. W. Murnau
note: 影子爬上楼梯的默片哥特，吸血鬼电影的原型。
noteEn: A shadow crawling up the stairs — the ur-text of vampire cinema.

title: 月光光心慌慌
creator: John Carpenter
note: 迈克·迈尔斯的面具与五音符配乐，开创砍杀片模板。
noteEn: The Shape, the mask and the motif — the template of the slasher.

title: 德州电锯杀人狂
creator: Tobe Hooper
note: 链锯与皮脸在德州农场的暴行，粗粝的纪录式惊悚。
noteEn: A chainsaw and a face of skin — grindhouse brutality as documentary.

title: 现代启示录
creator: Francis Ford Coppola
note: 沿湄公河溯流而上寻找上校，战争是精神崩溃的镜像。
noteEn: A river voyage into madness — the Vietnam War as a journey into the self.

title: 全金属外壳
creator: Stanley Kubrick
note: 新兵营的口号到街头狙击手，库布里克拆解战争中的灵魂。
noteEn: Boot-camp chants and a Hue sniper — Kubrick strips war to the bone.

title: 拯救大兵瑞恩
creator: Steven Spielberg
note: 奥马哈滩头 24 分钟开场，战争片史上最真实的血腥。
noteEn: The 24-minute Omaha Beach landing — the most visceral combat ever shot.

title: 野战排
creator: Oliver Stone
note: 新兵在老兵的善恶两极间撕裂，奥利弗·斯通的越战自传。
noteEn: A grunt torn between sergeants of good and evil — Oliver Stone's tour of duty.

title: 细细的红线
creator: Terrence Malick
note: 瓜岛战役中的自然独白，马利克的诗化战争。
noteEn: Guadalcanal war seen through nature's eye — Malick's lyrical combat.

title: 自己去看
creator: Elem Klimov
note: 少年目睹游击队村的毁灭，白俄罗斯炼狱的灼眼真实。
noteEn: A boy watches his village erased — Soviet cinema's scorching anti-war.

title: 光荣之路
creator: Stanley Kubrick
note: 法军将领用士兵性命换取荣誉，军事法庭的荒谬正义。
noteEn: Generals court-martial their own men — the absurd justice of war.

title: 从海底出击
creator: Wolfgang Petersen
note: U 型潜艇的深水炸弹与幽闭恐惧，德国视角的海战。
noteEn: Depth charges and claustrophobia inside a U-boat — war from the German side.

title: 西线无战事（1930）
en: All Quiet on the Western Front (1930)
creator: Lewis Milestone
note: 一战战壕里的少年凋零，反战电影的早期丰碑。
noteEn: Schoolboys withering in the trenches — an early monument of anti-war cinema.

title: 西线无战事（2022）
en: All Quiet on the Western Front (2022)
creator: Edward Berger
note: 新版把战争拍成绞肉机，获最佳国际影片等三项奥斯卡。
noteEn: The 2022 retelling renders war as a meat-grinder, winning Best International Feature.

title: 敦刻尔克
creator: Christopher Nolan
note: 陆海空三线交叉剪辑的敦刻尔克撤退，时间本身就是敌人。
noteEn: Three timelines converge on the beach — time itself is the enemy.

creator: Sam Mendes
note: 一镜到底穿越战壕送信，把一战拍成实时炼狱。
noteEn: A continuous single-shot dash across No Man's Land — WWI in real time.

title: 血战钢锯岭
creator: Mel Gibson
note: 拒持枪的军医在钢锯岭空手救下 75 人，信仰的奇迹。
noteEn: A conscientious objector saves 75 men unarmed — faith under fire.

title: 拆弹部队
creator: Kathryn Bigelow
note: 拆弹兵的肾上腺素上瘾，伊拉克战场的心理拉锯。
noteEn: Bomb-disposal as addiction — the psychology of war in Iraq.

title: 硫磺岛来信
creator: Clint Eastwood
note: 从日方视角写硫磺岛，战争双方都并非英雄。
noteEn: Iwo Jima from the Japanese side — no heroes, only soldiers.

title: 桂河大桥
en: The Bridge on the River Kwai
creator: David Lean
note: 日军战俘营修桥的道德悖论，大卫·里恩的殖民史诗。
noteEn: A bridge built for the enemy — Lean's moral paradox of command.

title: 雁南飞
creator: Mikhail Kalatozov
note: 战争撕裂的恋人，苏联电影首夺金棕榈。
noteEn: A war-torn romance — the first Soviet Palme d'Or.

title: 萤火虫之墓
creator: Isao Takahata
note: 兄妹在空袭余烬中求存，动画反战的最痛之作。
noteEn: Two orphans fading in war's embers — animation's most devastating anti-war cry.

title: 阿拉伯的劳伦斯
creator: David Lean
note: 沙漠起义与自我神化，宽银幕史诗的巅峰。
noteEn: A desert revolt and a self-made myth — the summit of widescreen epic.

title: 帝国的毁灭
creator: Oliver Hirschbiegel
note: 地堡里的最后 12 天，把希特勒还原为凡人悲剧。
noteEn: Twelve days in the Führerbunker — the human face of an empire's end.
